title: BountyVault
creator: notz
summary: MIT-licensed bug-bounty escrow template source and walletless browser simulation. The proposed flow records report hashes, lets sponsors approve or reopen a bounty, and lets a fixed trusted referee resolve disputes; timeout refunds the sponsor. The referee still judges report validity. The current README explicitly says the template is unpublished on Esmeralda and mainnet, and its Live tab is a placeholder. November 17, 2026: server-side extraction of the linked demo returned empty content; the creator-provided simulation destination is retained, with the README as the source walkthrough. No wallet or template was executed.
cardSummary: Explore bug-bounty escrow, sponsor decisions, fixed-referee disputes and timeout refunds through Rust source and a walletless browser simulation.
